entries.text: Fixed Parquet conversion of generated data: backslashes are preserved, decimal values that overflow their declared precision now fail the conversion, quoted delimiters no longer hide a trailing delimiter, sharded tables convert in numeric chunk order, and output bytes no longer depend on input chunk boundaries.
details: Parquet written by the previous writer is regenerated: the writer identity is now benchbox-pyarrow-streaming-v2 (benchbox-pyarrow-partitioned-v2 when partitioned), and caches carrying the earlier identities are treated as stale.
Dataframe CSV-to-Parquet caching now loads the null marker (for example __NULL__) in nullable string columns as NULL while keeping empty strings.

entries.text: Fixed benchbox convert --format ducklake, which the command offered but the conversion orchestrator rejected with Unknown format: ducklake.
